adminOnly: The project administrator manages and publishes the organization's websites.
intro: The project has one website: VitePress in the project's root (settings and theme in .vitepress/, pages in Markdown in web/). It is built into .vitepress/dist/ and published to hosting over SFTP, to one target or to all.
select: Select the website or a publishing target from the list.
newIntro: A VitePress website is created in the project: a home page and an About page in web/, settings in .vitepress/config.mjs. Only the pages in web/ are published, never the project's other files. You can edit them here, in Files, or ask the assistant.
buildHint: Building saves the finished website to {{dir}}; publishing uploads it to the targets.
addTargetHint: Add a publishing target in the list.
hostKeyPending: The server key is saved on the first connection.
confirmRemoveTarget: Remove the target {{name}}? The files on the server stay.
keepKey: The stored key stays unless you paste a new one.
keepPassword: The stored password stays unless you enter a new one.
sealed: The password and key are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
title: Website title
pagesIntro: Pages are .md files (index.md is the home page), images belong in public/; settings and the theme are in .vitepress/ (Files).
